author: vlogbrothers
description:
In which John discuses his forthcoming book Hollywood, Ending, his first novel since 2017 and first novel ever for adults. Signed copies are available for preorder at http://hollywoodendingbook.com provided you live in the U.S. or Canada. 
INTERNATIONAL PEOPLE: I'm sorry it's not possible to preorder the signed edition outside the U.S. or Canada. The book will be published internationally, including in the UK and Brazil, but I don't yet know if/where/when signed copies will be available in those places.
